{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored blazer, structured fit, hip length, navy blue (#1B2951), wool blend
Relaxed trousers, straight cut, ankle length, charcoal grey (#36454F), cotton twill
Silk blouse, classic collar, cropped hem, cream white (#F5F5DC), silk
Loafers, rounded toe, mid-calf height, taupe brown (#D2B48C), leather
Structured handbag, rectangular shape, shoulder drop, navy blue (#1B2951), smooth leather

This outfit strikes the perfect balance for a bank analyst interview by blending professional polish with approachable everyday elegance. The navy blazer and tailored trousers convey reliability and competence expected in the financial sector, while the cream silk blouse adds a touch of softness that prevents the look from being too severe. By strictly avoiding black as requested, the ensemble uses deep but warm tones to project confidence without appearing rigid or overly formal for a morning event."}
